161003.description:
This One Shot was published in "Weekly Shonen King" as the second part of "Kami no Toride" in January 1975. The war is finally over, but this time a desperate food crisis has come, and Tetsuro Osamu struggle to survive has begun again.
Osamu steals potatoes from the fields, draws portraits for the occupation soldiers, and receives sweets in exchange for pocket money. For those who have to make it through the day, even the dead bodies of the dead are out of sight. Although the story is light-hearted and filled with gags, it has a sense of reality that could only have been depicted by someone who actually lived during this period. Initially, Tezuka planned to make this a trilogy of "Kami no Toride", but the third part was never drawn.

161006.description:
A short story published in the magazine "Weekly Shonen King" in September 1974 to commemorate the 30th anniversary of Tezuka Osamu's career as a mangaka. It is a semi-autobiographical manga that depicts Tezuka's main character, Tetsuro Osamu, modeled after Tezuka himself, who desperately lives his life with a passion for manga while the war intensifies day by day at the end of the Pacific War.

In the postscript to the Kodansha edition of Tezuka Osamu's Complete Manga Collection, Tezuka wrote that the manga "contains a great deal of fiction", but many of the events depicted in the manga are based on his own experiences, which he also wrote about in his essays and other writings.

The two begin to mold a deeper connection as their lives become intertwined; but when Suyeon’s ex-boyfriend – and first love – Choi Gyeol makes a sudden appearance, an unbridled sense of jealousy and possessiveness becomes impossible for Yoonho to ignore. Mama ga Inu ni naru Hi
Muchimuchi Mama to Haretsu suru Sei
むちむちママと破裂する精
ムチ肉女教師 友美ママ
エロ漫画編集者 絵美ママ
ママはむちむちロードレーサー

161342.description:
What do manhwa characters do on Christmas? Curious, the brown bear editor decides to become Santa and collect the Christmas stories of manhwa main characters and present them to readers!

1. Mulmangcho Romance (물망초 로망스, Forget-me-not Romance) [Hwiyo]
2. Renjeuppal Hongseoksun (렌즈빨 홍석순) [Dogeumi]
3. Winter Game (Winter Game, Winter Game) [Go Je-Hyeong]
4. Boricha Mat Yeoreumbanghak (보리차 맛 여름방학) [Mingda]
5. Hakgyogyaedam (학교걔담) [Seohu, Daengppang]
6. Saengjonilji (생존일지) [Lee Ing-Gan]
7. Nae Jjakkkungeun Oegyein (내 짝꿍은 외계인) [Si Myo-Il]
8. Nabiui Sangja (나비의 상자) [Domino]
9. Gyeongniimul (격리이물) [Park Seong-Yong]
10. Maeirui Seonmul (매일의 선물) [Hanger]
11. Very Normal Ending (베리노말엔딩, A Very Normal Ending) [Yu Chang-Jae]

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161343.description:
An arctic band consisting of a polar bear, an arctic hare, an emperor penguin, and a conifer! I just wanted to enjoy a normal life, but due to climate change, everything started going wrong.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161344.description:
Stories of geeks who can't live without coffee and regular customers who can't live without coffee made by gwangnyangs.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161345.description:
“I've just recently found out that I can neither be seen nor heard. Now what??”

Four people try running away from their problems, all for different reasons. Then, they suddenly become invisible?! They’ll have to face the reality from which they ran in order to become visible once more.

(Source: Comikey)

161347.description:
Ho Chi Minh is a city full of friendly people, unique scenery, and delicious food. A small but heartwarming omnibus story drawn by an artist who lived in Vietnam.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

161349.description:
This world is too harsh for a pitiful herbivore. Here's a deer that runs around and lets loose(?).

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161350.description:
A mysterious manhwa shop has appeared! They say that you can make a manhwa into a dish so you can 'taste' it yourself... A story of presenting the world's only 'taste of manhwa' to guests who come with their own stories.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161351.description: The "psycho suspense" manga follows Godai, a policeman who was removed from the investigations division of the police due to violence toward criminals. He teams up with Hidaka, a man who is a self-proclaimed "paranormal police investigator" with claims to have the ability to send Godai in the past to prevent all the horrific crimes that happened, is that even possible and what will be the consequences?

title.english: Psycho×Past: Uncovering the Bizarre Murder Cases
title.native: サイコ×パスト 猟奇殺人潜入捜査
title.romaji: Psycho x Past: Ryouki Satsujin Sennyuu Sousa

161353.description:
Makoto loves singing but after a certain incident, he doesn't sing in front of others anymore and now he only does so while facing the sea. Then one night, he meets a young boy called Nobuaki. He found himself feeling comfortable with Nobuaki just quietly listening to him singing but by the time he realised it, Nobuaki had disappeared. Makoto has found himself unable to forget about him ever since.

This is the slow and long story of unrequited love between an unemotional guy and a commendably single-minded guy.

(Source: Homesha, translated)

title.native: 夜明けのリトルマーメイド

161354.description:
Mr. Park Jae-Gyu starts his day in the forest. But the only thing peaceful is the forest itself, as the office worker Mr. Jae-Gyu's head is cluttered with private thoughts. Oh, life is so hard!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161355.description:
After graduating from the Design Department, Hyeon-Ji is alone among friends who are preparing to find jobs. She returns to her hometown to help her father with farming and to find faith in herself.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161356.description:
"Yoo-Yeon chances upon the Middle World Sauna."

In this place regarded as the waypoint and resting place at the center of all worlds, she meets the mysterious man Myo Wol...

(Source: Comikey)

161357.description:
If we're just friends, why am I blushing? Model student Yuseong finds an unlikely friend in Dabin, the school's troublemaker, after he promises to help her get her grades up. But there are strings attached and Dabin must return the favor. Will both of them get what they want? Their high school lives are about to get a lot more interesting...

(Source: Manta)

161358.description:
Min Deul-Le graduated art college and dreams of becoming an artist. However, six months after graduation, he applies for a job as a trainee at a company. His status as "trainee", rather than "intern" or "temp", makes him aware of the grim reality of his situation.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Note: The main character's name, Min Deul-Le (민들레), means "dandelion".

161359.description:
One cold winter, Se-Ra, who had just experienced her first breakup, is introduced to a man named Kae-Se by a friend. However, they experience many twists and turns, and a great deal of trouble! Will these two be able to make it safely across the finish line?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Notes:
- Chapter count includes a prologue
- The title is a play on words: it can be translated as "Kae-Se and Se-Ra" (the character's names), or it can refer to the well-known phrase "que sera, sera", meaning "whatever will be, will be".

161360.description:
A grandfather selling his memories with used books. But he doesn't want to listen to other people's memories. Suddenly the local superstar dog shows up in front of him.

"Woof, do you want to play with me?"

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161361.description:
Ji-Yu and her parrot have a grand plan to find gifts for her mother! But their perfect plan keeps going wrong...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161362.description:
After failing a résumé screening process, jobseeker Bo-Ra comforts herself by cooking hearty dishes whenever she gets tired. A tasty story of ripening and growth.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161366.description:
Even if they look different every time, their appearances never change, and like the moon revolving around the earth, their love for each other is always the same.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161367.description:
After losing her lover, Na-Gun, who sees the whole world in gray, spending every day listlessly. Then one day, she meets Ji-Yeong, whose face is full of colors...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161368.description:
Love is hard, even for grown-ups.

After a heart-wrenching breakup, Cho-Rong decides to chase her dreams. Three long years of studying for the civil service exam finally come to fruition – her new life is just starting now! But her new workplace brings about an unexpected reunion...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.english: In the Flower of Our Youth

161369.description:
The boy I helped when I was a young girl is now a famous S-rank adventurer!?

Mina, an innkeeper's daughter, has absolutely become the beloved of Alois, an S-rank adventurer who she had helped in the past.

Because their social standings have become completely different from when they were kids, she felt daunted and intimidated by the gap between them, with the words
"Maybe I should just find a husband already..." escaping from her mouth. This only served to fan the flames of jealousy from Alois.

"Would you like to have lunch with me?"
With those words, Alois invited Mina to his room. Immediately following this, he pushes her down onto his bed.

"You're an S-rank adventurer... You don't have to settle for a plain and boring innkeeper's daughter like me... I'm sure there's plenty of cuter girls out there for you..."
How will Alois respond after hearing these words from Mina?

Featuring intense, clingy and loving sex that just won't stop even after she cums over and over!

(Source: DLsite garumani, translated)
synonyms: The Innkeeper's Daughter That Was Doted On By The S-Rank Adventurer

title.native: 宿屋の娘はSランク冒険者に溺愛される
title.romaji: Yadoya no Musume wa S-Rank Boukensha ni Dekiai Sareru

161371.description:
The story takes place in the near future, when technology has advanced to the point where "Maid Robots" are widely used. Yashiro, a salaryman for a black company also has a maid robot named Meruru, however she has a dangerous secret that even Yashiro doesn't know?!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 人間メイドロボめるる
ちびっこ先生のひみつ保健室
異世界転生 母～えっちでレベルアップ!?～
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei Haha: Ecchi de Level Up!?

161374.description:
Pure, a rookie succubus, tries to tempt the high school boy Tatsuo Hoki. Pure is not confident in her seduction skills, but in order to meet her company quota, she has to collect sexual energy by fulfilling Tatsuo's desires! This is a pure-hearted succubus comedy that doesn't unfold in the usual ecchi way!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Notes: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Succubus Division's Super Stiff Staffer Pure

title.native: サキュバス課の真面目なピュアさん

161376.description:
Weiss, witnesses an elf girl being sold into slavery. When he realizes that the girl is not just an elf, but a rare species of elf (High Elf), he decides to buy her and raise her as his daughter.

Weiss is at the mercy of raising a child for the first time. Nevertheless, thanks to his efforts, the girl, who was battered and unable to speak, regains her health. Her name is decided to be "Lily," after the first word she spoke.

Weiss, who has become a parental figure, is now busy with his goal of getting Lily to attend a magic school!

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)
synonyms: My daughter was an unsold slave elf.

title.native: 売れ残りの奴隷エルフを拾ったので、娘にすることにした
title.romaji: Urenokori no Dorei Elf wo Hirotta node, Musume ni Suru Koto ni Shita

161378.description: Note: include two one-shots: Watashi no Hokenshitsu e oide... (私の保健室へおいで…) and Mune Sawagi no Kusamura (胸さわぎの草むら)

161379.description:
A stroke of the pen on the divorce papers, and she was left with nothing. No money, no home, and too old to be attractive. But Xia Xinghe will fight back one day, by becoming a top-notch computer hacker, she will build a new fortune for herself.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Zui Shan Liang De Xing He

title.english: My Loyal Husband After Our Divorce
title.native: 离婚后前夫成了我的忠犬
title.romaji: Lihun Hou Qianfu Cheng Le Wo De Zhong Quan

161380.description:
1. San-chou-me no Satin Doll (3丁目のサテンドール)
2. Tsuruhime Aiwa (鶴姫哀話)
3. Rumiko-san ni Hanataba wo (流水子さんに花束を)
4. Nadare no Iesu (なだれのイエス)

title.native: 十二月、君は青いパズルだった
title.romaji: Juunigatsu, Kimi wa Aoi Puzzle Datta

161382.description:
Jin Mita, a farmer in the countryside, discovers a female knight lying in the rice paddy. When he asks the knight, who calls herself "Seraphim," about her story, it seems that she came from another world. The female knight, suddenly thrown into modern Japan, naturally has nowhere else to go, so Jin takes her in, and in exchange she'll help with his farm. Jin teaches Seraphim, who has no understanding of this world, about agriculture, modern society, and life in the countryside. However, they look just like an ordinary couple to everyone around them....... Before long, people all treated Seraphim like she's Jin's wife...!

(Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)

title.native: 田んぼで拾った女騎士、田舎で俺の嫁だと思われている
title.romaji: Tanbo de Hirotta Onna Kishi, Inaka de Ore no Yome da to Omowarete Iru

161384.description:
Vol. 1
1. Sekizou ni Natta Shoujo (石像になった少女) [Fumihiro]
2. Kouri no Sekai (氷の世界) [Tendou Masae]
3. Toraware Princess (囚われプリンセス) [Nyanko]
Vol. 2
1. Mushibamu Ningyoukano Jubaku (蝕ム人形化ノ呪縛) [Tousen]
2. Sekiban ni Naru Onna Hakaarashi (石版になる女墓荒らし) [144]
3. Haiboku Shita Yuusha-Tachi (敗北した勇者たち) [Zutta]

title.native: 二次元コミックマガジン 状態変化でバッドエンド！
title.romaji: Nijigen Comic Magazine: Joutai Henka de Bad End!

161385.description:
In a divided world, a boy and a girl were enemies. Therefore, they killed each other over and over again. But when they were united, the world began to change...

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.native: エンド・オブ・アルカディア

161386.description:
An exhilarating first time you'll never forget.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2023-03

synonyms: A Boy Who Loves Genderswap Got Genderswapped, so He Acts Out His Ideal Genderswap Girl

title.native: TS好きな男子がTSしたから全力で理想のTSっ娘を演じるやつ
title.romaji: TS Suki na Danshi ga TS Shita Kara Zenryoku de Risou no TS-kko wo Enjiru Yatsu

161388.description:
Saika Kuozaki is an all-powerful witch with looks to die for. She's also the only woman who can thwart the mysterious entities attempting to destroy the world once every 300 hours. When Saika is mortally wounded, however, she bequeaths both her powers and body to the normal high school boy who happens upon her, Mushiki Kuga. But just because Mushiki has her abilities doesn't mean he can control them. To stand a chance of saving the world, he'll have to attend an academy for mages as Saika—all while keeping his identity under wraps!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: includes an extra chapter.

161389.description: Note: R18 extras are published on the author's Pixiv Fanbox account.
synonyms: A Girl Who Looks Really Easy So If I Confess To Her She'll Completely Fall In Love

title.native: チョロそうだから告ったらガチ惚れする奴
title.romaji: Chorosou dakara Kokuttara Gachi Hore suru Yatsu

title.native: 猫は恩返しなどしない。

161391.description:
One day, Chad the dog suddenly bursts out talking. Choi Chung-Eun, who lacks a partner, sets out on a journey to find out why the dog started talking. In the meantime, he discovers the reality behind a famous pet shop company...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161392.description:
So-Yeong is a workaholic who came to Canada with high expectations, but is tired of her repetitive daily life. She meets Yu-Jin at a party, and when she sees her dance, her heart starts pounding for the first time in her life.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161393.description:
Manhwakyung artists are out on Environment Day! Start out by drawing manhwa on discarded paper...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161394.description:
Have you ever met yourself in a parallel universe? This is the story of the world Yu-Jin lives in, where he thinks about Yu-Jin while looking at himself.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161395.description:
When I came out of my mother's belly and opened my eyes, there was a child following me! Even though they are a little different from others, they are always pleasant. Twin brothers exploring alleys.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161396.description:
Indie band vocalist Seong-Dae prepares for a contest with a song about his girlfriend, Eun-Seo. However, the closer he gets to music as he spends time with the band, the more he starts to neglect Eun-Seo.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161397.description:
Enjoy a drink that reflects your heart. The bar was located in a residential area. Or maybe it was between two business districts. Inside the bar, a beautiful bartender makes a drink "just for you". Only you can tell whether that drink will be sweet or bitter for you---a deep heartbreak, a crossroads in life, a nostalgic love, a man from the past, a decision for the future...

A person with various thoughts opens the door to a certain bar. A drink made by a beautiful bartender can change someone's life. I hope this book will be a "precious drink" for you...

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: 今宵もお待ちしております

161398.description:
Min-U, a local cafe owner, is visited by a strange woman. She tells absurd stories while pushing flyers with coffee robots. Min-U gradually falls into the world of sales without even knowing it.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161399.description:
Nyangnyangland, where cats live. One day, in this peaceful place, the number of cats who bark like dogs suddenly increases...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161400.description:
The year was 2006. A time when just being an "otaku" was looked down upon. One man who lived through the "Otaku Ice Age" travels back in time! Otaku, this is a second chance to relive your lost youth!

(Source: Gekkan Sunday, translated)

title.native: 平成ヲタク リメンバーズ

161401.description:
In order not to lose oneself in the unfamiliar city life, spend a day eating, feeling, and living the four seasons.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161402.description:
Baek-Gu is a hyena who was ostracized by her pack, so she decided to run away to Korea. There, she eats a pot of rice with Savannah, who mistakes her for a cat, and her friend Kim Mi-Jin...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161403.description:
Although they were close friends, the prince and his bodyguard had no choice but to confront one another. One day, the two embark on a sudden journey...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

synonyms: The Book of the Licentious Thief

161405.description:
The "π-naple" is an organization for the elimination of corrupt spies who disturb world peace. From the Japanese branch of the organization, 00Goro and 00Hachiro, are in pursuit of Dr. Ootake when they are interrupted by something. It is Mad Machine, a robot spy organization that steals secrets from all over the world and sells them at a high price!

Also included are "Sπ", "5SS (Five Six Seven)", "Pink Tiger", and "Super Express Reporter Hatoko Chan".

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

161406.description:
Casual gamers and skill gamers just aren’t meant to get along. But what if the extremes of both are forced to team up? When Junghoon dives into the world’s most mysterious new VR game, his craving for pure fun leads to a strange stroke of luck when his permanent patron spirit turns out to be Kang Jinho — a real-life hardcore gamer who’s stuck serving as an NPC! Are they doomed to annoy the hell out of each other? Or is there more to this game than either one could have ever found on their own?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Got Lucky and Pulled a 10th Rank Summon
ガチャで最強10星級プレイヤー

title.native: オタクOLと年下男子〜私の推しはキミじゃないのに！〜
title.romaji: Otaku OL to Toshishita Danshi: Watashi no Oshi wa Kimi ja Nai no ni!

161408.description:
“Who needs a bandit, anyway?”

That’s the last thing Ikoma Ichinose, a bandit-class hunter, heard before he got kicked out of his party and ran into a monster that would kill him. But he was given a second chance at life in the form of a time-turning pocket watch.

“Yeah, who needs a bandit?”

This time, Ikoma chooses to be a gravity master to have a shot at becoming the greatest hunter of all time.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: 重生為重力控制者挑戰最強
เป้าหมายครั้งที่ 2 ต้องเป็นสุดยอดผู้แข็งแกร่งด้วยคลาสลับ

title.native: 2周目冒険者は隠しクラス〈重力使い〉で最強を目指す
title.romaji: 2-shuume Boukensha wa Kakushi Class "Juuryoku Tsukai" de Saikyou wo Mezasu

161409.description:
2222 A.D. Nyakano, Tokyo. In this city where cats who have acquired intelligence and human rights live alongside human beings, the story of amazingly energetic girls who will save the love of this world unfolds.

(Source: natalie, translated)

161411.description:
A town is swept by a zombie virus of unknown origin which originated in a puppy mill. The struggle of a dog named Do-Bi who is protecting his zombie guardian begins!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161412.description:
While thinking about her career ahead of graduation, Hwa-Jeong, an art student, starts working as an instructor at the academy of a senior she had a crush on in the past. The story of Hwa-Jeong's conflicts between dreams and reality.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161413.description:
Ghastly, red-eyed Lynn is a zombie… but unlike the others she still has the capacity to think and feel. Lynn is living alone among her fellow zombies when she meets Rawon, a man in search of his family. The two band together to set out on what may be the most treacherous adventure of their lives.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

161414.description:
A mermaid washed up on the shore. It is said that there is something to be done in the human world... Su-Jeong, who saved the mermaid, reluctantly helps, and gets involved in all sorts of strange things.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161415.description:
Ru-Ri gets kicked out of all women's clothing design studios because of her short stature. Will Ru-Ri be able to make her dream come true?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

161416.description:
I can be a main character too!

A-Reum Han, an extra in the fictional world she inhabits, knows her role by heart — from gossiping in the cafeteria to picking on the female lead. But slipping on the stairs? That wasn't in the script! It's no ordinary fall either because she tumbles out of the pages... into the real world!

(Source: Manta)

161417.description:
I'm just a regular guy, who has just transmigrated into the body of the Demon Lord. Now I have to breed with all sorts of monster girls to help revitalize their tribes! There's the sexy phoenix girl, the cute ferret girl, the muscular panda girl… this is going to suck me dry, maybe I'm better off going out to conquer the world instead!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Chong Sheng Zhi Wu Huang Wan Shui
Rebirth: Ten Thousand Sleeping With My Emperor
Tuyệt Sắc Đạo Lữ Đều Nói Ngô Hoàng Thể Chất Vô Địch
I am the Crowned King of Hearts

title.english: My Furry Harem Is After Me
title.native: 绝色道侣都说吾皇体质无敌
title.romaji: Juese Daolü Dou Shuo Wu Huang Tizhi Wudi

161418.description:
Do Sulmi was so excited to start her new life as a freshman at Hanguk University, but she’s quickly discouraged after being incessantly bullied by her classmates for her looks and weight. Baek Dojoon on the other hand, has always been incredibly handsome and wildly popular amongst his peers. They’re both students in the Genetic Engineering program, which is in possession of the “Transbody,” a state-of the art machine that allows the user to change their human form into whatever they choose. After a late-night accident in the lab with the Transbody, Dojoon is left with an affliction where each night he involuntarily changes into a beautiful woman. Sulmi would do anything to escape her current body while Dojoon would do anything to return permanently to his old one. Will Sulmi and Dojoon be able to transform their fates and find a happy ending?

(Source: Lezhin US)

161419.description:
Na-Bi suddenly lost her mind one day. From that day on, she begins to have unusual dreams, and develops a strange affinity to butterflies...

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Note: Na-Bi (나비) means "butterfly".

161420.description:
There is a world where "Soul Plants" grow, plants that reflect a person's unconsciousness. Mary is a "soul gardener" who helps people who are suffering from this. Strange and mysterious events happen in her daily life.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

synonyms: 仲神家の一族～大家族SP・三男が入り婿を連れてきた～

title.native: 仲神家の一族～仮面舞踏会で逢いませう～
title.romaji: Nakagamike no Ichizoku: Kamen-budoukai de Aimaseu

synonyms: Me, an Evil, and Language of Magic

title.native: ぼくとアクマと魔法のことば
title.romaji: Boku to Akuma to Mahou no Kotoba

161425.description:
As an omega abandoned by his betrothed alpha mate, shut-in Minoru shares his heartbreak with the world in the form of music. But when one of his songs catches the attention of famous idol Hijiri, Minoru is suddenly swept from the lonely solitude of his room and thrust into the spotlight — as an omega idol and music producer performing alongside his two alpha bandmates, Eiji and Tatsuya!

For any other group, this could prove a recipe for controversy and disaster, but Minoru isn't worried; his lingering attachment to his former mate keeps him from acting on his omega instincts. For a while, he's even able to throw himself whole-heartedly into his new role, learning to embrace the world he'd once retreated from, and even growing closer to his bandmates and fellow idols, especially the frank and affectionate Eiji. But Eiji is hiding a secret of his own — a connection to Minoru's past that might shatter the tentative trust and affection that's been growing between them.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.english: Heat x Beat: A Shut-In Omega Becomes an Idol!
title.native: Heat×Beat～引きこもりオメガがアイドルに！？～
title.romaji: Heat×Beat: Hikikomori Omega ga Idol ni!?

161426.description:
Every few decades, the town of Hokutochou sends a human up the mountain to marry one of the fox spirits who reside above them–and Inaho has always longed for that role. When he comes of age, he ascends to his new home and meets his handsome new husband: a kitsune lord named Subaru. Subaru has been watching Inaho for a long time and is pleased to receive his new spouse. But before this supernatural marriage can enter its honeymoon stage, Inaho learns that Subaru is stuck with an unfortunate curse. This fox spirit wants to eat up his beloved: literally! Can Inaho and Subaru find a way to break the curse and save their relationship?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 自由研究☆ビッチレポート

161433.description:
Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break!

Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. They are fed, sheltered, pampered, and looked after by Ollie and the other gardeners—and even a gilded cage is better than the cruelties of the outside world.

Aconit's haughty façade of careless allure masks his own old wounds and deep distrust of humans, but Ollie sees through his surface beauty to the lonely, resentful creature beneath. In turn, Aconit finds his cold heart stirred by Ollie's tender affection and innocent intentions. A haunting dark fantasy debut from Harta’s acclaimed catalogue… witchcraft, mirrors, and memory intertwine in a supernatural mystery where every reflection hides a truth waiting to be uncovered.

In a world where mirrors are more than simple reflections, they serve as gateways to something far more dangerous. A young girl’s quiet life begins to fracture when she encounters a mysterious witch, one who doesn’t just see through mirrors, but manipulates what lies within them. As strange occurrences ripple through her town, reality itself seems to blur, and the line between memory and illusion becomes dangerously thin.

Each reflection reveals fragments of hidden truths: forgotten pasts, suppressed desires, and unsettling possibilities. But the deeper she is drawn into this mirrored world, the more she risks losing her sense of self entirely.

Created by Togawa Yonan, this debut volume showcases a distinctive voice emerging from the prestigious Harta manga catalogue, known for nurturing atmospheric, auteur-driven storytelling. With delicate artwork and an unsettling tone, Black Witch Mirror Vol. 1 offers a slow-burning descent into psychological fantasy, where every page invites readers to question what is real, and what is merely reflected.

(Source: Penguin Random House)

Over a thousand years, he's mastered hundreds of languages and every instrument imaginable, and perfected skills in fighting, driving, shooting, cooking, dancing, acting...and more. But on this very day, something changes. July 8th, 2020 finally arrives...

Sei, a Korean adoptee living in a small French village, accidentally finds a hidden hotel owned by her family. After her friends decide to run the hotel together, a big change occurs in her life.

161708.description:
A first-year high school boy, Nagumo Hassaku, gets called "Hakushaku-sama" because of his tall stature and intimidating appearance. He wants to make friends, but he has trouble talking to people, so he lives his high school life as a loner. Until one day, when he accidentally discovers the secret of Noa Yagami, the most beautiful gal in his class...

When she gets excited, a large tail pops out!

A heartwarming romantic comedy between a monster-gal and an introverted boy!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

161712.description:
Beautiful, charismatic Mitsuki has it all. She's got so much, in fact, that she sends her more timid sister Tsukiko on dates disguised as her so Mitsuki doesn't miss out on other things. But one such body swap backfires after Mitsuki gets engaged: Mitsuki asks Tsukiko to stand in for her at a wedding planning meeting, and Tsukiko ends up falling into bed with Mitsuki's groom-to-be! Tired of playing second fiddle to her beautiful sister, Tsukiko decides to take something for herself for a change. In this startling tale of intrigue and romance, revenge is a dish best served steaming hot!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Volume 3 includes the one-shot "Nandemo Hoshigaru Haruna-chan". Volume 4 includes a side story and the one-shot "Fake: Gossip Reijou no Fukinshin Days".

161714.description:
The curtain rises. Bastian Klauwitz and Odette von Dyssen begin their act for the empire, playing the perfectly enamored couple who are engaged to be married. But beneath the facade, the two are only playing the part as a means to their separate objectives. What they don’t realize yet is that they may be more alike at heart than they seem… In a maze of misunderstandings, secrets, and revenge, will Bastian and Odette be each other’s salvation or destruction?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

161715.description:
Yeon was just an orphan on the streets when a man claiming to be her father brought her to his family home. But the Baengri estate was a den of vipers that swallowed her whole, and it's only when she's standing at the funeral of the father she never truly understood that she realizes how familiar this story is. When she wakes up six years old again, Yeon knows she can't waste her second chance. This time, she's going to save her father. This time, she's going to live without regrets.

(Source: Tapas)

161716.description:
A mysterious serial killer could be hiding in the darkness, silently observing their prey! Or, they could be completely indifferent, passing by innocent civilians... They might greet you with a friendly smile, but then suddenly swing a knife! Or another possibility is... that you are the one who's the killer...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

161717.description:
A salesman who lacked motivation, Haijima dislikes his female boss, Rukia-san. However, ......! A masterful romantic comedy depicting the relationship between a woman and a man, a tightrope walk between love and pride.

161718.description:
In a world where angels protect the people against demons, a young orphan with pitch-black wings may hold the key to the kingdom’s fate.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

161719.description:
A beautiful and enigmatic girl, Midoriko Hibiya, transfers to the class of Morio Suzuki, a very ordinary high school boy. It turns out she has two faces. By day, she is a slightly eccentric high school girl. After school, she is a member of the Golden Rose Society, which can make any wish come true, even murder, for the right price...!?

Suzuki is a nice guy, and he tries to befriend Midoriko, who doesn't care about fitting in at school... But the strange requests that keep coming to the Golden Rose will involve them in some unusual incidents...

(Source: Booklive, translated)

161720.description:
In a world where heroes and villains live among humans, ACE hero agency and the Olymforce villains are in a constant power struggle. ACE hero Evan (codename Roid), blessed with super strength, is an impenetrable wall of force and power. The only thing that can make him crumble? His roommate Nolan, who he’s been crushing on for over three years. However, everything comes crashing down when Evan nearly catches the elusive teleporting villain Hermes…only to discover that he’s been Nolan all along! Stuck between his unwavering sense of duty and his unrequited love, Evan has a choice to make: turn Nolan in to keep the city safe, or help keep the villain’s identity hidden for a chance at love. With great power comes great responsibility – whether you want it or not!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

title.native: こどもおんせん -るなちゃんのばあい-

161722.description:
Everything happened because of a coffin that emerged from the river… I thought it was an unexpected fortune for me, but alas, it was an untimely disaster. After prying this coffin open, I instantly felt that something unpleasant had followed me back to my home. As my daughter started acting increasingly weirder, she—as a three-year-old—started hitting puberty!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

161723.description:
Based on the tale of the Journey to the West, the Demon-Slaying Chronicles are a retelling of the story, reimagining them as dedicated demon slayers instead of pilgrims for sacred texts. The author interprets the story as the four main protagonists fighting for justice freely, not fearing power and status, and neither doing so for the "greater good". From the White Bone Spirit, Sea Spirit, Nine-Headed Beast, Azure Lion, White Elephant, Great Peng, to the battle to the death with the Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord, all of it was done for the sake of justice, and not as trials and tribulations in the way of acquiring sacred texts. A clear distinction between being pilgrims and demon-slaying is made, where the former is for an intangible "greater good", while the latter is easier to grasp. Between the both, the four choose the latter, and to quote what Jiang Liu'er says to the Buddha: "I am but a simple monk, and our paths simply do not coincide."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

161724.description:
The Han siblings, the brother and sister who stayed secluded, have embarked on a journey because of a dream.In her dream realm, there are thousands of species, and the people are ethereal and beautiful.There is warmth and coldness in them; there is love and hatred; there is affection and resentment. Most importantly, they are waiting for her arrival.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

161725.description:
Ian Wilson, the CEO of Wilson Corporation, was unjustly accused of murder after his company’s artificial intelligence robots were involved in murder incidents. While making his escape from arrest, he met Colin, his new staff, who was then being dragged into the case. As they set out to find out the truth, they discovered a series of old events, and to their surprise, everyone around them seemed to be connected to the hidden truth…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

161726.description: A human drama set in a riverside hotel at the boundary between this world and the next.

161730.description:
An ordinary teenager's left eye experiences a sudden transformation. He then starts gambling on precious stones and treasures and begins to get surrounded by beautiful women. He proudly laughs as he starts living a dashing life in the city.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

161733.description:
Jihyun’s mastery of the blade did more than win competitions. It also made Haekyum, a sword-turned-legendary being, fall deeply in love with him. While Jihyun grapples with the loss of his little brother, Haekyum steps in to fill the void in his heart. However, things take a turn when Haekyum decides to confess his true feelings and reveal his identity. Doubt creeps in—is Haekyum just a replacement for Jihyun's brother or something more?

(Source: Tapas)

161734.description:
Lee Beom, a member of Space Boys who ended up in the “deadweight” group. Thanks to his handsome looks, he was the only one to successfully renew his contract, and after appearing in a drama, he was riding high, landing all kinds of commercials...

“It's symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia.”

Following his manager's advice, he visited a urologist only to receive a thunderbolt diagnosis! But... why is the doctor so incredibly handsome too?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

161735.description:
What happens when a boy dresses up as a girl to try to become the princess of the otaku club.

(Source: Pixiv, translated)

161736.description:
In a world devastated by a nuclear disaster 400 years ago, the privileged few found refuge in the Ark, while the outsiders mutated into beasts. Helm, a young biologist in the Ark, lives a life of indulgence...or so it would seem. Reluctantly engaged in a power struggle with his own half-brother, Helm spends his days indulging in frivolity in an attempt to stay free from his brother's clutches. Yet his life takes a surprising turn when a captivating outsider tries to hold him hostage. Faced with a choice, Helm escapes the Ark, only to realize that the dangers outside may be more treacherous than he ever imagined...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: ちちちちちち おっぱい百合合同誌

161738.description:
I've always admired my boss, Akira Okita. He's always considerate towards his subordinates, but it seems he has something on his mind lately... "Please let me know if there's anything I can help you with!" I blurt out before I can think. I just want to do something for him, but I never thought that this outburst would lead to me taking on a job as his model! It turns out that Akira is actually a rather famous painter, and while the deadline of his exhibition is approaching quickly, his model had suddenly canceled. Not confident whether I'd be good enough, I head over to his art studio. There, a shocking discovery awaits me. All of Akira's works portray intimate moments between men. That night, Akira and I have an intimate moment of our own, his brush gently caressing my body...

(Source: Renta!)

"Dear mom & dad, the school dorm I'm living in now is nice. My roommates are three lewd, attractive girls. I'm sure I'll be fine."

161740.description:
The handsome model Yura gets a new, stern manager. But his serious and strict character is the worst match for someone as sloppy as him! Plus, he even ends up moving into the same apartment building as his manager, Shiina, after making the decision to "put serious effort into work"...! Even though he thought he'd find this meticulous and diligent guy annoying, Shiina's sincere kindness and his brief smile makes Yura's heart race for some reason... They're so close to each other, but nothing's happening... a slow burn romance story.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 隣のつれないマネージャー

161741.description:
Rein the Enchanter is a support mage with the ability to enhance weapons and armor. But when he gets fired from his guild for the simple reason that he's already enchanted everything they own, he decides to take the power back into his own hands—literally! Rein recalls every enchantment he ever put on his guildmates' gear, retrieving the bonus points for himself. But does he really not have anything better to enchant with them than some Plain Clothes and a Copper Sword…? Come along on a cheat-tier journey from the most common of common origins!

(Source: K MANGA)

161742.description:
"I'm thinking of becoming a VTuber, and I want you to draw my character, so I DMed you."

One day, the illustrator Murasame-sensei suddenly receives a DM. The client, Minami, is an extremely attractive and extremely unstable girl. As Minami becomes more and more famous as a VTuber, Murasame-sensei develops feelings for her that maybe he shouldn't…!?

(Source: Ichijin Plus, translated)

161747.description:
A demonic creature created by a forbidden and hidden enchantment since ancient times... When it parasitizes the uterus of young women, they fall prey to a compulsive sexual desire and seek sperm at all costs, thus falling into the madness of pleasure...

Albrecht, a scholar in the art of magic, discovers this enchantment and decides to infect the young girls of the city!

title.native: 淫獄の皇姫ディートリンデ

161748.description:
Hikari and Airi were best friends with a strong bond. They were always thinking about and supporting each other. However, changes in their weights have also led to changes in their relationship.

This is a story of two women, tied down and struggling under ideas of how much they should weigh.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

161749.description:
Average college student Il-Han Yu has always gone through life without being noticed by anyone, even God! So when monsters were about to invade Earth and God sent all humans to other dimensions to train with mana... he forgot Il-Han and left him on Earth for 1,000 years! Realizing his mistake, God sends the straggler two angels to assist him as he takes on the monsters, eventually turning him into an unstoppable force. Now that people have returned to Earth, will Il-Han finally be seen?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: 俺以外全員帰還者な件

161750.description:
After finding a mysterious book in the imperial garden, Princess Philomel not only discovers that the book's villain shares her name, but that other events in the story are coming true too. Now, she believes that she's an imposter and that the real princess will take her rightful place, leading to the execution of Philomel the Fake! So to avoid a tragic death, she has to make sure the rest of the book doesn't come true. Can this fake princess change what's already been written?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: No Place for the Fake Princess

Elm, the legendary Dragon-Armored Knight who once sealed six demon kings and saved the world countless times... is now a humble villager in the countryside! But what happens when he "accidentally" uses his OP skills...?

161755.description: After an unexpected accident, distraught Tsubaki Tsukishiro is left in denial of his sister's death. But after a moment of despair, he has an epiphany, "I don't need to exist if my sister is here." Donning his sister's clothes, he ventures out with the resolve to erase the existence of Tsubaki in favor of reviving Chika. But while passing through the streets on the day of her funeral, a man calls out to him with a single word, Chika?
synonyms: The Day I Became My Sister

161756.description:
Eulji So Moon has aged well and is now a grandfather. He orders his mischievous grandson to go on a joyful trip to Zhongyuan! To save the fallen Namgung family clan and help them spread their wings once more, Eulji Ho’s journey starts now!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

161762.description:
Due to his lack of talent, Seonghyeon gave up acting and became a writer. Seonghyeon is a genius author with a natural talent for screenplays, but he still misses acting. Then one day, he got into a truck accident on set.

“If I’m born again, I have to act”, he promised and closed his eyes.

Seonghyeon returns 13 years back into the past to when he was 24 years old. And the method acting ability that goes into his scripts became the character itself! Okay, this life is about being reborn as a genius actor!
synonyms: I Became a Top Actor Just by Reading Books!
I Will Be the Best Actor Just by Reading Books!
Comike Daisuki Kyoudai no Nichijou ~Serihin Hen~

title.native: コミケ大好き兄妹の日常～戦利品編～
title.romaji: Comike Daisuki Kyoudai no Nichijou: Senrihin-hen

161764.description:
Some doors should stay closed.

Jaeho is a genius but receives little recognition. He opens a clothing store, unaware that the building he rents is hiding a secret portal to another world! One day a man emerges, speaking in tongues. How does he know Jaeho’s name? Where is he from? Most importantly, what does he want with Jaeho?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: The Legend of the Fitting Room Gatekeeper

title.english: The Legend of the Fitting Room Watchman

161765.description: One year after the events of the anime, the three girls are third year middle school students, and the story begins when they are preparing for high school exams. Setsuna is helping rebuild Labyrinth, but visits them. Love cannot decide her dream for the future, and is envious of her friends who are studying for the exams each with a specific goal in mind. Then, suddenly, a person dressed in a suspicious black cloak who calls themself "Mafisto" appears, creating monsters called "Fushiawase" one after another, and the town panics! The four girls become Pretty Cure again with the Linkrun, the surprising identity of "Mafisto" will be revealed and the Cures transform into their Angel forms again!? Soular, Westar, Tart and Chiffon also play a role!

title.native: 小説 フレッシュプリキュア！

161768.description:
Aurora has always had a habit of picking up random things off the streets since she was young. A chicken, a horse, and now… a person? When Aurora finds Jovian passed out and injured in the forest, she brings her in and takes care of her like family.

However, despite Aurora's kindness, Jovian keeps her at arm's length. It's obvious that Jovian is hiding a secret, but Aurora is willing to wait until she opens up. But when the village sheriff comes looking for Jovian, it's a matter of time until Aurora finds out that Jovian might not be the person she thought her to be...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

161769.description:
1. Asuka Mukashigatari (飛鳥昔語り)
2. Zigeunerweisen (チゴイネルワイゼン)
3. Boku no Naka no Alice he (ぼくの中のアリスへ)
4. Kimura-kun no Neko Blues (村木くんのネコぶるーす)
5. Sakura no Mori no Mankai no Shita (桜の森の満開の下)
6. Kazari Mado no Akane Neesan (飾り窓のあかね姉さん)
7. Tsuruhime Aiwa (鶴姫哀話)

161770.description:
Donghwa’s turning 25 years old. An occasion to celebrate, right? Well, it would be if he wasn’t all by himself at a bar, drinking his sorrows away. The guy he’s actually got a crush on, his roommate, is at work. Plus, his roommate doesn’t swing that way anyways, Donghwa’s just foolishly holding out hope that someday he’ll come around. Down on his luck in love and in his work, nothing seems to be going his way. But when an expensive-looking man, with the kindest eyes, approaches him at the bar, Donghwa's heart starts to flutter. Will this man be the solution to all his problems, or will his life get even more complicated…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

161771.description:
Taisuke enjoys spending time with his neighbor's cat, Kuro. Friendly and cute, and I love cats! It's heaven for Taisuke.

One night, a man who looks just like Kuro appears before Taisuke.

"Both cats and people are really cute..."

I got drunk and pushed him down and had sex, but when I woke up, he wasn't there...

(Source: Kasakura, translated)

title.native: キャッツ イン ヘイヴン

161772.description:
"What if we became friends with benefits...?" Suuna, a gloomy high school student, leaves home to live in a dorm. But when she nervously enters her room, she finds her roommate, Ruka, feeling up another girl! She finds out Ruka needs a "friend with benefits," so Suuna takes charge and proposes they form a "(semi) friends with benefits" contract...?

(Source: Yen Press)

Notes:
- Originally published as three chapters, was then picked up for serialization.
- Includes five extra chapters.

161773.description:
Yoichi Todo, a humble factory worker, got killed in a truck accident along with another young man. A woman claiming to be the Administrator appears before them, in a pure white space that seems to be the afterlife. Just as he was expecting that he and the young man would be given cheat abilities and be reborn in a fantasy world of swords and magic… he is told that he wasn't supposed to be caught up in the accident. But as a result of his complaints, Yoichi is given the special powers of Appraisal, Infinite Storage, Language Understanding, and Return, before he is sent on to his next life. He wakes up with high hopes of escaping from his past life as a working stiff and start enjoying the freedom of life in another world. But no matter how you look at it, he seems to be back to the same world that he came from…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

161774.description: Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 34 (June 1967).

synonyms: A Girl Wanting to Die Over the Slightest of Things

title.native: ちょっとしたことで死にたい子
title.romaji: Chotto Shita Koto de Shinitai ko

161776.description:
Nanami Naruse is a former member of the idol group "Seishun Junjou Otome Girls." After graduating from her idol activities, she returns to her parents' house in the countryside, where she meets Naoto Kusaka, a handsome high school student. Naoto, who is cool and open-minded, seems to misunderstand the baby-faced Nanami as a younger, middle school student...

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)
synonyms: I Want to Go Back to Being a Normal Girl

title.native: ふつうのおんなのこにもどりたい

161777.description:
What happens if a bartender ex-boyfriend (top) x hairdresser (top) x band-man (bottom) do a threesome...?! 3 men in the ""top 3 professions you shouldn't date"" in a house-sharing love triangle...?! I'm Atsushi, an easily influenced, struggling musician. My hairdresser, Shiki, asked me: "Why don't you come to live with me and my friend?" He isn't just good at his job, he also knows how to make me feel pampered even when I try to play tough, so I'm attracted to him. But, his friend turns out to be my ex-boyfriend, Enraku. I was madly in love with him, but he betrayed me and I never wanted to see him again... "Do you hate me so much...?" he's pushing me against the wall, and I'm about to get overpowered, but...!!?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra

161778.description:
A tale of parent and child that surpasses even the divide of species.

From the award-winning author pen-named Suzuka Morino, published as one of her debut oneshots in Harta magazine's March 2022 Issue No.92.

161779.description:
Otomo works as a chef-in-training. He lives in a two-bedroom apartment, which is a 13-minute walk from Nishinippori station in Tokyo. He shares it with his landlord, the mysterious Shuichi Kinoya. Shuichi's job: unknown. His personality: a mystery. Does he even have a girlfriend? Who knows? Otomo tries everything to get Shuichi to open up, but the two end up getting physical one night, instead! What will their relationship turn into? Can it be... love!? This is an unusual love story between two men living under the same roof.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: This Isn't Going to End Well
title.native: 上手にできてたまるか

161780.description: A saboteur appears at the construction of a huge dam in the Arab Federation and takes the lives of the people involved. It is Muse, a mare leopard that speaks human language. It is a magical beast guarding the temple of King Azothus, which was discovered at the site. Tadashi Nagano, a Japanese boy, and his dog, Don, fight to the death against this great enemy.

161781.description: After defeating two hundred aliens, Ushio and Ajishima, members of the Pan-Earth Defense Police League's suicide squad, are forced to return on foot through the desert due to a vehicle explosion. Taking five aliens as prisoners.

161783.description: Fourth-grade investigator Youkei is the best assassin in the universe. He visits a desolate planet far from Earth and points his gun at an old woman who lives alone in a witch's house. However, a confrontation with her reveals an unexpected past... A sci-fi version of the legend of the cannibalistic demoness Adachigahara.

161785.description:
Many new Pokemon dwell in the Sinnoh Region. Satoshi and Pikachu journey with a new Trainer, Hikari. What awaits these two on their journey?
(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ポケットモンスターダイヤモンド&パール

161788.description:
A human-eating queen, and the human she falls in love with -- what lies at the end of the recipe for these two?

Note: Prize winning one-shot from the second round of the Yatagarasuhai "Yatagarasu Cup" Competition, later published in Harta Vol. 91.

161789.description:
Just what kind of world is beyond the gate across the river?

Prize winning oneshot from the first round of the Yatagarasuhai "Yatagarasu Cup" Competition published in Harta magazine's August 2021 Issue No.86.

161790.description:
There’s something on Taejoon’s mind. He’s been dating Yeona long enough that they know each other’s bodies inside and out, but something's missing. Something that’ll add a thrill to their perfect relationship: a threesome. However, when he finally brings the topic up, Yeona threatens to break up with him. That only piques his interest in the forbidden topic, and he soon comes up with a plan to go through with his ultimate fantasy.

(Source: Lezhin X)

161791.description: One day, a boy in a mountain village whose heart was darkened by his parents' divorce, saw a baby antelope stuck in a log on a suspension bridge and decided to took care of him.

161792.description: Taro, the brother of Yajiro (a mentally handicapped boy), was conducting research to improve the intelligence of animals. His experimental rat Yajiro was released by Yajiro and was named Yaji.

161793.description: Musa was born at the top of a thousand two hundred year old camphor tree. He was abandoned by his father soon after birth, but caught on a lower branch and encouraged by the camphor tree's voice, he survived and grew up alone.

161794.description: The three Ezo wolf brothers Roro, Lulu, and Lili chase after their stuffed mother, but two of them die on the way.

161795.description:
Duchess Yuria had a memory of her previous life as a researcher at an agricultural college. She was living in the poor estate she was going to inherit by breeding crops, but the king asks her to become the fiancée of the second prince, Riglas, who has a bad reputation. Yuria's family, the Dukes of Cornelia, is a prominent family, and they are an attractive backer for the two princes who are competing for the crown.

However, Yuria who was small and overweight, was called a pig by Riglas at the arranged marriage meeting and fortunately, the engagement talks were dropped. Briefly relieved, this time, Lauren, the first prince proposed to her, and because of their mutual interests, Yuria became Lauren's fiancée. ......

But, she didn't know. In fact, this world was the setting of a certain Otome game in her previous life, and she herself was supposed to be a villainess and Riglas' fiancée.

A romantic fantasy that begins with a fatally broken scenario due to the actions of a reincarnated Rikejo who knows nothing about it!

(Source: Saga Forest, translated)

Note: Silver Prize winner of the 1st Hifumi Shobo WEB Novel Award.

title.native: 元農大女子には悪役令嬢はムリです!
title.romaji: Moto Noudai Joshi ni wa Akuyaku Reijou wa Muri desu!

161796.description:
Duke Rotary obsesses over which of his sons will be his heir, and the battle to succeed him is vicious. Born a boy, but raised as a girl by his mother to spare him a hard life, Crystal Rotary lives in peace until the Duke tries to marry him off. To protect his secret, he flees and offers himself to the rival Duke Illian Pentrin, hoping to hide there until he can escape for good. Little does he know he's not the only one with secrets. Can Crystal run from his past, or will his lies ensnare him?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

161797.description:
One day, I found a hole in the yard of my house. It was just right for a garbage hole, so I threw away my garbage in it.

I threw away the household garbage. I threw away business garbage. I threw away construction trash. But, the hole is still not filled...

Note: Gold Prize winner of the 1st Hifumi Shobo Web Novel Awards.
synonyms: I got a hole in my garden.

title.native: 庭に穴ができた。ダンジョンかもしれないけど俺はゴミ捨て場にしてる
title.romaji: Niwa ni Ana ga Dekita. Dungeon ka mo Shirenai kedo Ore wa Gomisuteba ni Shiteru

161798.description:
It has been a few decades or so since dungeons appeared on the earth and demons roamed around the world.

However, the era of adventurers as in the stories did not come, and many towns have been abandoned, the economy is in decline, and the world is full of lawless zones that are slowly heading toward extinction.

Amano Hobito, who has been training his own skills in the abandoned towns where death is the norm, and Shizuku, a mysterious beautiful girl with whom he shares a common destiny through the "Zanki" skill, challenge to save the world that coexists with dungeons using their unique skill, "Equivalent Exchange Store" as weapons...!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)

Note: Grand Prize winner of the 1st Hifumi Shobo Web Novel Awards.

title.native: アースウィズダンジョン〜固有スキル≪等価交換ストア≫を駆使して世界救済を目指します〜
title.romaji: Earth with Dungeon: Koyuu Skill "Touka Koukan Store" wo Kushi Shite Sekai Kyuusai wo Mezashimasu

161799.description:
"Show me more of your cute crying face."
"Gh...! Who'd want to show you...?"

University student Mizuki suddenly gets close to Kyouya, the younger twin brother of his crush. He's never talked to him, but he seems to be a pretty good guy...? He barely had time to think about it, but Kyouya already seemed to know who Mizuki likes...!? Confused, he even ended up revealing that he's a crybaby! The trouble doubles! Even worse, Kyouya pushes his hot tongue into his mouth, making his hole tingle. "Let me make you cry."

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: The crybaby's at the mean devil's mercy

title.romaji: Nakimushi-kun wa, Ijiwaru Akuma no Iinari

161812.description:
Never ending murders and accidents... People around her have turned up dead since she was a little girl... One day, the girl who attracts death is saved by a young man with cold eyes…

(Source: Pocket Comics)

161813.description:
Takako, whose determination is her best trait, and Kaname, a smart, handsome, and popular boy at school, are in love with each other. But Kaname's strict mother, known as "The Iron Lady," discovers their relationship! Now a deep and wide river named Mother stands in their way. Happiness is on the other side! They cross a dangerous bridge! What will happen to their love?

A collection of four short stories by Noriko Nakayama!

(Source: Booklive, translated)

161814.description:
Seong-U quits his cafe job of five years to prepare for his public service exams but one day, he wakes up to an unfamiliar room. He soon finds out that he is in a world where drinking breast milk is ordinary. Then he stumbles across the chance to become the owner of a breast milk cafe!

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: Milking Girls in a Fantasy World

161817.description: Souma Takeshita practiced day in and day out with Akari Jingumae, Beninosuke Meiji, and Hinata Tougou with the goal of performing an original band song at the school festival. 3 years after forming, they managed to complete the song and show it at the school festival, but failed their performance. After losing confidence and motivation, Souma's older brother and former famous band member Aoshi agrees to become their manager. In order to challenge the quota of 1,000 fans in three years, beginning at the school festival held in Autumn, they will start activities again as Mics!!

161820.description:
Jiang Chengfeng is a confident and arrogant teenager who has atheist views ever since he was a child. Due to an accident in the past, he has the power to defeat evil spirits turning him into an exorcist. Jiang Chengfeng uses his power to defeat every demon and spirit in order to challenge the Lord.

(Source: INKR)

161825.description: Valentino, the former head of Venice, is a woman but pretends to be a man. While putting Venice first, she acts to make her loved ones happy in the midst of suspicious people surrounding her. A historical romance short story.

161826.description: Aelia wanders from town to town with a wound in her heart that will never heal, until the day she leaves the earth and is free.

161828.description: Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

セルロイド・ドリーミング

title.native: アズ・タイム・ゴーズ・バイ

161835.description: James, handsome, well-educated, and brilliant, is the adopted son of a family prominent in the English aristocracy. James is curious about his origins and wants to know why he was abandoned. Unknown to James, he is the son of the former King of France, Louis XIII, and the elder brother of King Louis XIV. In fact, James and the present king are twins. Louis XIII could not have children for a long time. When finally he had a baby boy he immediately announced that a prince, the heir to the throne of France, had been born. But just after this a second boy was delivered and in the case of twins the second one born is considered older than the first. The king thought it would be a bad omen if he had to announce a different heir...

161836.description:
Tsukishima, Tokyo, is known as the land of the Monja. One of Kanto's famous local food. Because of some circumstances, Yuzuki (21), the eldest child of the Umikawa family, is forced to become the second owner for the family's Monja restaurant business! Not only is he responsible with managing the business, he also has to come up with new ideas to keep the business going! However, his little sisters showed no sign of helping him!

"Please my little sisters, help your brother!!"

161837.description:
Eunkyung's homelife is... boring, to say the least. With no job, no kids and a distant husband, she's beginning to feel depressed. Things start looking up when her hunky young nephew moves in, but having all that extra testosterone in the house proves stressful! To relieve her tension, Eunkyung decides to take up yoga - only to find out her nephew is the instructor! She's got a lot to learn, and he's a very thorough instructor. Who knew yoga was so hands-on?!

(Source: Lezhin X)
synonyms: My Aunt Is a Yoga Student

161839.description:
In order to save her little sister's life, S-ranked adventurer Laffey seeks an all-healing elixir. However, elixirs are highly precious items that take years to make by even the most experienced alchemists. But one day, she meets a man that defies these rules!

"Here, an elixir. Oh, it's fine, I can always make more."

A slow-paced fantasy about an extraordinary alchemist who doesn't know his own worth and a beautiful adventurer girl who gets caught up in his efforts to help others!

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: He's an Alchemist. His Own Weight Has Been Thrown Into the Trash.

title.english: I’m an Alchemist Who Doesn’t Know How OP I Am
title.native: 錬金術師です。自重はゴミ箱に捨ててきました。
title.romaji: Renkinjutsushi desu. Jichou wa Gomibako ni Sutetekimashita.

161840.description:
A young charming man has some fun with his dad's mistress and gets kicked out of the family mansion in the countryside. He isn't too excited to move until he comes across the maids in the house.

(Source: Toomics)

161841.description:
Seeing life through someone else’s eyes seems appealing, but less so when it’s your own eye that was gouged out by a murderous serial killer. Fortunately for Dongsu Ha, he’s a Connect – an immortal being with supernatural healing ability. Thanks to this strange power, Dongsu is able to see through his stolen eye, which the killer is still using. Dongsu must use this connection and his newfound ability to track down his killer and recover his eye before more innocent people are hurt, but at what cost?

(Source: WEBTOON)

161842.description:
A very special prison with only women!

Ahn Tae-Seong, one of the world's leading conglomerates, creates a very special women's prison in order to protect his precious daughter Jiae. There, Jiae forms her own harem and continues her debauchery life. However, in there she also meets Eun-Ha, who has been charged with attempted murder. Intrigued by the other woman, Jiae pretends to help Eun-Ha in her jailbreak plan, but falls into a world of lust with her...

161843.description:
The story takes place at the Dachkammer Brewery, where Crowe Ida works as an apprentice, and his childhood friend Anna Winter, who set out to become a craftsman and eventually a master brewer. But he first must learn the art of beer making: the great beer halls, the huge kettles, the purity ordinances, the traditional dirndl, the old-fashioned bottling machines, and the purchasing of malt and hops…

Join Crowe and Anna as they learn about the great culture of beer step by step.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ネコと鴎の王冠 (クローネ)

161844.description:
The main character is Maya, a woman who already has her own shop as a master brewer (meister). She is physically robust, and the beer she makes is delicious, but she has one problem: she has a crush on the brewery's co-owner, Nils. She is a strong, independent woman, but her love is pure as a maiden...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: キツネと熊の王冠 (クローネ)
ジャジャジャジャーン!
エージェントBBA-倉庫騒乱編-
オタクに優しいギャルに優しいオタク
title.romaji: Otaku ni Yasashii Gal ni Yasashii Otaku

title.native: ダーリン・イン・ザ・サーキット

161851.description: Note: Published in Digital Puni Pedo! Vol. 26

title.native: 手錠くすぐり我慢対決！

161852.description:
Ichijo-san is a beautiful girl from a wealthy family who treats everyone, including her introverted classs-mate Mahiro, kindly. But she has a secret: she is a vampire. When Mahiro accidentally discovers that Ichijo is a vampire, he begins to eat lunch with her. Ichijo-san tells him that vampires can just drink animal blood now, but she still seems very interested in human blood....... The exchange unfolds between Ichijo-san, who cannot hide her desire to suck human blood, and Mahiro, who just enjoys having lunch with her.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

title.native: 一条さんは顔に出やすい

161853.description:
Don't you think about anything else other than food…??

Eliza is a young lady who is only interested in "food." One day, a delinquent girl named "Misaki" shows up offering "delicious local specialties" for her. Misaki seems scary, but... Eliza just can't resist those delicious snacks!

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

title.native: ないしょのおふたりさま。

161854.description:
One day, the demon Claude appears in front of the novice nun Sister Chris Ibarakawa. He says that he made a contract with Chris's estranged father, whose final wish was for Chris to live a happy life. Claude, who is very serious even for a demon, tells her "I will do anything to make you happy," by using all of his demonic powers.... Will Chris be able to stay on the pure and righteous path?

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

title.native: シスター様の仰せの魔々に
title.romaji: Sister-sama no Oose no Mama ni

161855.description:
I am healthy, handsome, wealthy, and good with the ladies. However, I was suddenly told that I'm doomed to die soon… and the reason is because that I'm too well-liked by beautiful women. Well, it can't be helped, in order to stay alive I'll just have to use all sorts of dirty tricks to make all those lovely ladies break up with me. But I underestimated my opposition. Who knew making beauties dislike me would be so hard!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

161856.description:
Due to a difficult relationship with her mother while growing up, our mangaka's has lived with incredibly low self-esteem, always feeling like "I hate myself." In order to let go of those awful feelings, Pon Watanabe begins to treat herself how she wanted her parents to treat her, which finally allows her heart began to loosen up little by little.

"You can still be happy, even if you can't forgive."

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

title.native: 自分を好きになりたい。自己肯定感を上げるためにやってみたこと
title.romaji: Jibun wo Suki ni Naritai. Jiko Kouteikan wo Ageru Tame ni Yattemita Koto

161857.description:
"Your body's too sensitive. It was like porn sex..." Kasumi Sugisaki became deeply traumatized by sex after being told this by the first man she's ever slept with. After accidentally drinking too much, her secret was found out by her co-worker, Kurokawa. However, Kurokawa also has a trauma of his own...! The two decide to work together to "break the curse" and begin a relationship therapy!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.romaji: Koi no Noroi wa Ai de Toke

161858.description:
Rimuru and his friends go to the "Magic Tower", a place where magic from all over the world gathers to develop new special moves, and they are supposed to be busy with their research, but they get caught up in a conflict...

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 転生したらスライムだった件 番外編 ～とある休暇の過ごし方～
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Bangai-hen - Toaru Kyuuka no Sugoshikata

161859.description:
Chesterhill Academy, an all-boys boarding school...
A school where the students are trained to be as proper as angels, where the students who behave are guaranteed success in life after graduation. A self-righteous new teacher, Taiga, arrives at the school. There, Taiga meets a devilish student named Luca. Their encounter will be the trigger for a murder in this "Garden of righteousness." The devil will shake Taiga's sense of justice...

A school suspense that questions what is good and what is evil!

(Source: Gangan Joker, translated)

title.native: そして悪魔は正義を騙る
title.romaji: Soshite Akuma wa Seigi wo Kataru

title.native: はにとらっ！ 召喚勇者をハメるハニートラップ包囲網
title.romaji: Hanitora! Shoukan Yuusha wo Hameru Honey Trap Houimou

161861.description:
Magical girls, the allies of justice who fight against “Soul Eater”, monsters that devour the hearts of men, and protect the people. But in recent years, due to being damaged by a lot of bad rumors coming from anime and novels, the magical girl industry is currently plagued with a serious shortage of talents!

In order to defeat the Soul Eaters, it’s necessary to feed them with a magical girl’s bashful heart until it surpasses the limit——in other words, the magical girls need to feel embarrassed? Keeping that little secret sealed, the magical girl scoutman goes forth, even today!
